notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official English text as shown on PlayStation Network, taken 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (see sources). Two independent guides agree on all 55 entries.
Guides are written in our own words for this entry. Where a source has not confirmed an unlock method, the guide says so and the trophy carries guide_unconfirmed: true — no method is invented.
Cheats disable trophies and saving. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
The only trophy reported as possibly missable is Positive Mental Attitude (Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation).

planetgta6.name: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies: All 55 trophies and Xbox achievements
planetgta6.note: Official English names, descriptions and grades as shown on PlayStation Network, taken 18 Nov 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements.

outputlag.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
outputlag.note: Full 55-trophy list with grades and Gamerscore, checked 18 Nov 2026; unlock methods for robbery, free-roam, partner and side-story trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. It is the last trophy you will earn, so use the checklist here to track everything else.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is the first story mission, so this pops early and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins, so keep playing if it does not appear at once.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies unlock in order as you complete the chapters.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story trophies unlock in order as you complete the chapters.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story trophies unlock in order as you complete the chapters.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, so a save lets you revisit the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks in the story flow and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks in the story flow and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks in the story flow and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks in the story flow and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks in the story flow and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks in the story flow and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which only appears after the story. Work you do before the credits still counts, so chip away at stunts, challenges, collectibles and side strands as you play.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — nine types in total. Sample one of everything the world offers rather than grinding a single activity.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. Practise each range's drills until the gold time or score is met.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total. Win at least one race at each spot on the map.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; vary the events rather than repeating the same one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the four in-game arcade games. Pick the game you find easiest and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's side-story strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's side-story strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's side-story strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies — so check this trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's side-story strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's side-story strand. Side-story finales stay open after the main story ends.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida; spots show as purple icons when you are close. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, follow her to the balcony of Jason's house in the morning — because it disappears once Chapter 1 ends. Meditating with your partner at outdoor spots should count for both characters.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret in his Jason-only hunting questline, working through his target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards around Leonida until three full sets are done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan things as you travel; the count builds up through normal exploration.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress and then Challenges. Many finish on their own while you play; the 100% checklist wants 70 of 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, lose a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs give you 4 stars at once, so escaping one with your partner earns this too. It pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob 3 shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level. If the stars fade and only the red heat zone is left, the chain breaks. Give it a moment after the third shop — it can take about 30 seconds to pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive; the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim (L3 and R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport before it pops. Save first: the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun: use it on a store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the safe code note inside, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; reload if anyone spots you.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It pops once you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every region of the map until the whole state is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact spot and trigger are not yet confirmed by the sources, so check a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and watch for the prompt; do not trust unconfirmed methods.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No source has confirmed the exact showroom or trigger yet, so treat any claimed method as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and illegal operation visited in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe, blown open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. Leaving something behind is fine: the operation comes back later.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reported to pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner, since the partner trains alongside you. The sources flag this as reported, not confirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Reported to need 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it should fill up through normal play; the count is reported, not confirmed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description gives no clear method and no source has confirmed one. Treat any claimed method as unconfirmed until a trusted source verifies it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description gives no clear method and no source has confirmed one. Treat any claimed method as unconfirmed until a trusted source verifies it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by: strike people with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The description itself names the method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts and the total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000; garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
